generate_gmock_classes: run gmock_class.py on a C++ header file to generate Google Mock classes for all classes
generate_gmock_for_class: run gmock_class.py on a C++ header file with a specific class name to generate its mock
generate_mock_methods: call _GenerateMethods to produce MOCK_METHOD macro lines for virtual methods of a parsed class node
generate_mock_classes_from_ast: call _GenerateMocks with an AST list to produce mock class source code lines for selected classes
parse_cpp_header_to_ast: use ast.BuilderFromSource to parse a C++ header file into an abstract syntax tree for mock generation
